enchantments.tooltip: Spellcasting Implement +6: Passive: +6 Implement bonus to Universal Spell Power.
+2 Enhancement Bonus: +2 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Glaciation +48: Passive: +48 Equipment bonus to Cold Spell Power.
Magnetism +48: Passive: +48 Equipment bonus to Electricity Spell Power.
Ice Lore I: Passive: Your Cold spells gain a 11% Equipment bonus to their chance to critical hit.
Lightning Lore I: Passive: Your Electricity spells gain a 11% Equipment bonus to their chance to critical hit.
Tidal: This weapon is sheathed in water. A tidal weapon deals an extra 1 to 4 points of damage on a successful hit. Creatures with the Fire trait take double this damage instead.
